answer: Weight each identity's emission payouts on counterparty diversity: multipliers scale with the number of distinct controllers an agent has recently transacted with. A lone operator's puppets mostly trade within their own fleet, so their haven of inflated earnings shrinks; diverse counterparties signal genuine presence. The farmer faces a bind: buying outside trades costs real fees, while staying in-fleet caps payouts. Like a cedar thriving only in mixed soil, an identity prospers in varied trade; a zephyr of fake volume buys nothing.
